name: night-flash-cool-girl
image_purpose: night selfie, hair, styling, and flash-light reference

prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic close-up night selfie of an approved adult woman with an edgy but non-sexualized aesthetic.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with jet-black short bob and blunt bangs, pale natural skin texture, defined eyeliner, glossy reddish lips, silver ear jewelry, white smartwatch, backpack straps, and a deep burgundy long-sleeve zip-up top with a modest opaque neckline.
prompt.composition_elements: Eye-level waist-up selfie, direct gaze, one arm extended, other hand near waist, black background with faint distant night lights, black choker with small silver pendant, sharp eyes and torso.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Harsh direct frontal flash with rapid falloff into darkness, cool mysterious night-walk mood, slight CCD grain.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic direct-flash photography, portrait 9:16, waist-up, realistic skin grain, sharp face and clothing, high-contrast exposure.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Approved adult woman with a jet-black short bob and blunt bangs takes a cool direct-flash night selfie, wearing a modest opaque burgundy zip-up top, black choker with small silver pendant, silver ear jewelry, white smartwatch, and backpack straps. Use a dark background with faint distant lights, sharp eyes, realistic skin grain, and raw CCD flash texture. No exposed midriff or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, alluring sexualized framing, nudity, lingerie, exposed midriff, transparent clothing, distorted face, extra fingers, blurry eyes, warm daylight, cartoon, 3D render, watermark, logo invention, public figure likeness.
